sloka: प्राकर अन्तर रथ्याः च वेदिकः चैत्य सम्श्रयाः ।श्वभ्राः च पुष्करिण्यः च सर्वम् तेन अवलोकितम् ॥५-१२-१८॥
transliteration: prākara antara rathyāḥ ca vedikaḥ caitya samśrayāḥ ।śvabhrāḥ ca puṣkariṇyaḥ ca sarvam tena avalokitam ॥5-12-18॥

translations.english: He moved in the lanes inside the boundary walls, around the shrines, altars, wells and tanks whereever it was possible to look for.
